title: बिगरी बात बनै नहीं, लाख करौ किन कोइ
author: Rahim
context: Traditionally attributed to Rahim, this is the complete, separately numbered doha no. 122 in Surendranath Tiwari's first-edition Rahim-Kavitawali (Naval Kishore Press, Lucknow, 1926). The edition's attribution is a historical tradition, not independent proof of authorship. This text follows the linked scan; spacing and punctuation are normalized. Hindi and hi are broad discovery labels for this historical Braj register, not a claim of standardized modern Hindi. The year is the edition date, not a composition date; India is an associated place, not a documented composition location. The 1926 witness reads ‘रहिमन बिगरे दूध के … होइ’; Hindwi's circulated version has ‘रहिमन फाटे दूध को … होय’. The historical wording is retained.

text:
बिगरी बात बनै नहीं, लाख करौ किन कोइ।
रहिमन बिगरे दूध के, मथे न माखन होइ॥

जहाँ काम आवै सुई, कहा करै तरवारि॥
